description: The project object model file that declares the project's coordinates, properties, dependencies and build configuration.
The groupId, artifactId and version triple that uniquely identifies an artifact in Maven.
A setting such as compile, runtime, provided or test that decides on which classpaths a dependency appears and whether it is passed on.
An ordered list of phases such as compile, test, package and verify, where running one phase runs every earlier phase first.
A unit of work bound to a phase, for example compiler:compile or surefire:test.
The mvnw scripts and properties file that pin and download the Maven version a project builds with.
A bill of materials POM that lists compatible dependency versions and is imported in dependencyManagement.
The spring-boot-starter-parent POM that manages dependency versions, the Java release and the Boot plugin for a project.
